minutes.headline: Select Board approved the Lane land purchase agreement and began FY15 budget talks; spend-or-reserve decision held a week.
minutes.summary: The board granted a solar peddler's license, approved the purchase and sale agreement for the Lane conservation land, and went through the town meeting warrant article by article, recommending some and holding others for more information. It reworked the public access cable committee bylaw and discussed how to use the remaining FY15 money, leaning toward the Lane property and the land use director and waiting on the finance committee for the rest.

what_happened.line: The Select Board approved the purchase and sale agreement for the Lane conservation land, with a state land grant reimbursement expected.
The board voted to recommend several town meeting articles, including the revolving funds, solid waste and water enterprise funds, the stabilization deposit and the Lane purchase.
The board held its vote on the sewer enterprise budget and asked the Sewer Commission to present the borrowing article next week.
The board voted to recommend the public access cable committee bylaw amendments as amended.
On FY15 requests above target, the board reached rough consensus to fund the Lane carrying cost and the land use director; the rest waits for the finance committee.

why_it_matters: The Lane purchase starts as short-term borrowing and moves to permanent financing the following year, so it adds to the town budget, mostly taxes, and Town Meeting voters will be asked to approve it.
Most of the above-target FY15 requests, a sewer fee and borrowing question, and a marijuana dispensary zoning article are still undecided, and each could change a tax or fee bill or a town rule.
watch_next: Finance committee meeting Thursday, then the board's final FY15 spending decision the following Tuesday.
Planning board invited April 22 to present the marijuana bylaw, and the Sewer Commission to present the borrowing article next week.
